name: strike-horizon
description: Strike Horizon - browser combat flight simulator with procedural worlds and five cities, 23 fighters, 6 bombers and special aircraft (B-2, B-1B, B-52, Tu-160, SR-71, F-117), 15 airliners including the A350 and An-124, a pre-flight story with ATC and taxi, a 19-mission campaign and free flight.
